hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT normal STA RX callback diagnostic FIT
inputs.revision: RAM-loaded diagnostic kernel from OS commit a88ec7252aa; FIT SHA256 identifies the tested package.

inputs.name: WPA2-PSK/CCMP/PMF0 profile and selected AP
inputs.revision: WPA2 trial against the configured AP; identifiers omitted.

scenario: On one operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample, run WPA2-PSK/CCMP/PMF0 using the normal STA RX callback diagnostic FIT, with bounded callback, hardware-RX and internal-pool counters.
expected: Associate and complete WPA, while recording actual STA callback frame types, opaque hardware counters and internal-pool pressure.
observed: The station associated but did not complete WPA; it disconnected locally with reason 204 after the PTK four-way handshake timeout. The AP record shows station deauthentication after the PTK timeout, but does not establish M1 transmission or acknowledgement. The live pTxRx table pointer remained stable at 0x80625408 and slot +0x3f8 matched the instrumented sta_rx_cb wrapper. The callback ran 141 times; all 141 frames were management type, with control/data/extension counts 0/0/0. This confirms management ingress to the normal STA callback, while no data frame reached that callback during the measured window; it does not establish whether data frames reached earlier hardware or ROM stages. The four older net80211 table-wrapper counters, crypto/decap/EAPOL counters remained zero and are not a proxy for this direct callback path. Hardware RX statistics were active (getter succeeded) but remain opaque and do not identify frame type. Internal-pool misses, successful fallback and final NULL were zero; window minimum free memory was 197136 bytes. WPA_COMPLETED was not observed.

measurements.name: disconnect-reason
measurements.unit: local disconnect after PTK four-way handshake timeout

measurements.name: normal-sta-rx-table
measurements.unit: stable pTxRx pointer; slot +0x3f8 matched wrapper

measurements.name: older-table-crypto-decap-eapol-counters
measurements.unit: calls; separate path and not a proxy for direct STA callback

measurements.name: hardware-rx-statistics
measurements.unit: getter succeeded; opaque values do not identify frame type

limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and one RAM-loaded diagnostic run; the result does not establish support for other revisions or persistent Wi-Fi operation.
The 141 normal STA callback entries were management frames; zero data callbacks in this window does not establish whether the hardware or earlier ROM stages received data frames.
Hardware RX statistics are undocumented/opaque and cannot establish reception of DATA or EAPOL, nor distinguish filtering from memory pressure.
Internal-pool misses, fallback and NULL were zero in this measured window only.
The AP record confirms association and station deauthentication after the PTK timeout, not AP transmission or station acknowledgement of M1.
No EAPOL input, WPA_COMPLETED, negotiated PMF, IP address, DNS or accepted network data exchange was observed. Wi-Fi support remains partial.
